description: Proposed v1 contract fixtures. All keys, tokens, URLs and data are synthetic; no TerraBase process or production credential is needed.

conventions.binary_strings: unpadded canonical base64url unless field name ends _hex
conventions.integers: offsets, epochs, replica ids and stamps are decimal strings; byte counts are JSON integers
conventions.http: headers shown are required subsets; body is parsed JSON, body_hex is exact wire bytes; Authorization fixture token is intentionally not a real JWT
conventions.negative_crypto: reject the complete object without applying any plaintext or advancing offset
conventions.generated_crypto: build plaintext_recipe, encrypt with fixed vector keys/salt, compare size/SHA256 and per-frame tags, decrypt, then test mutations
